viewing_check: Armitage estimate 30-50, current bid $15 (re-checked 9 Nov), 22% premium. Check the cases for hallmarks (STERLING/925 or a lion/anchor stamp would change the value) and how many complete sets there are. Small cased EPNS sets and souvenir spoon lots sold A$8 to A$30; only big 44 to 60 piece sets or a 179-spoon bundle reached A$100 to A$150 or more. All sales within 3 years (Jan 2024 to Oct 2026), prices flat.
